acceptedAnswer.text: EV Connect was founded in 2009, making us one of the first charging station management system (CSMS) providers. We’ve been simplifying commercial EV charging since the dawn of the EV revolution.
Our parent company is Schneider Electric, a global leader in energy management that has been named the world’s most sustainable company by multiple neutral third parties.1
EV Connect is headquartered in Lake Forest, CA, not far from the city where we were founded (El Segundo). Our platform has been deployed across the globe.

mainEntity.name: What makes EV Connect different from other EV software companies?

acceptedAnswer.text: EV Connect combines a proven, open software platform with dependable hardware options and the most complete suite of deployment and value-added services. Backed by Schneider Electric—the world’s most sustainable company1—we deliver the long-term reliability, flexibility and support that businesses need to scale confidently in a fast-changing EV landscape.

mainEntity.name: How is EV Connect’s charging platform unique?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our comprehensive CSMS gives you all the tools to manage your charging program, whether you’re operating a few stations or a nationwide network. Our platform is open and OCPP-compatible so you never have to worry about vendor lock-in, and it’s optimized for leading charging station brands for seamless integration.
Thousands of businesses rely on EV Connect for charging solutions—from local enterprises to Fortune 500s and national charging network operators.

mainEntity.name: How does Schneider Electric’s commitment support EV Connect customers?

acceptedAnswer.text: Schneider Electric’s commitment strengthens EV Connect’s resources and expertise while assuring customers of reliable charging solutions for the long term.

mainEntity.name: What industries does EV Connect serve?

acceptedAnswer.text: EV Connect helps all kinds of businesses unlock the value of EV charging—from charge point operators and fleet owners to utility companies, multifamily communities, commercial and workplace properties, retailers, restaurants and hospitality brands.
